contract.objective: Audit whether Chohogi can observe, reconcile, and correct cross-project planning, documentation, consumer-integration, and verification drift; determine the smallest safe disposition without changing active Chohogi assets during the audit.
requested: independent multi-perspective review of organism-wide observation and response gaps
cross-review of findings before an integrator recommendation
a bounded repair or no-change disposition with evidence and re-review conditions
excluded: changing Chohogi policy, runtime guidance, installer, or project code before causal findings are reviewed
treating a static verifier pass as proof of fresh-agent behavior
storing raw prompts, private reasoning, credentials, or user project data

acceptance.description: Three independent read-only reviews cover structural verification, runtime feedback circulation, and planning-to-consumer integration.
Each reviewer challenges the synthesized findings and distinguishes confirmed evidence from assumptions.
The final packet identifies affected Chohogi boundaries, the smallest owning asset or a no-change/provisional outcome, verification limits, and re-review conditions.
